D: Ledgers, every column added twice. The last line reads: OWED TO ME BY THE KINGDOM: EVERYTHING.
B: Account books, sorted by how much each person owes. One shelf is just for the Crown.
p: A plant. Its watering is logged.
W: The Archive's shelves run right through into here.
1: The door back out to the Archive.

lines: Ah. Come in. Don't touch the ledgers. Touching is a fee.
